h1: Cart improvements that keep shoppers moving
overview: The cart is where shoppers pause and decide. We set up a slide-out cart drawer, show how far they are from free shipping, and add one or two sensible add-on suggestions beneath the items. Quantity changes, discount code entry and the checkout button stay easy to reach on phones. We test each change with real orders in your store and write down what we set, so you can adjust it later.

faq: Do I need a paid app for a cart drawer?
Sometimes. Some themes include a drawer already. If your theme does not, we use the cheapest reliable option and tell you the monthly cost before installing anything.
Will the cart work with my discount and shipping rules?
Yes. We test with your real discount codes and shipping rates, and we note anything that behaves differently in the drawer from the full cart page.
Can the add-on suggestions be chosen by hand?
Yes. You tell us your best pairings, such as a case with a phone or a cream with a brush, and we set them up. Automatic suggestions are used only where you want them.
Does this slow my store down?
We keep the code light and check page speed before and after. If an app adds too much weight, we tell you and choose a lighter route.
